capture.mjs: the aria object each measured element carries (issue #937) omits the aria object for an element with none of the nine, and records nothing unlisted

why: Records every one of the nine attributes on every element, writing an empty string for the ones it lacks. An absent attribute then becomes indistinguishable from aria-label="", which is a different accessible name, and every measured element grows nine keys of noise that bury the attributes that exist.
